rules.goal: Reach any unfilled portal at z=0 without dying.
rules.movement: UP: z-1 if z>0. DOWN: z+1 if z<12. LEFT: x-1 if x>-5. RIGHT: x+1 if x<5. WAIT: stay idle, with river drift. Illegal directions do nothing and are recorded as invalid.
rules.timing: World is frozen while you answer. Once your action arrives, obstacles move first, then the command is applied. A hop lands after 8 further physics ticks. WAIT runs 9 ticks before your next decision. No log drift during a hop.
rules.roads: Rows 7..11: a grounded frog dies if abs(frog.x-car.x) <= car.length/2 + 0.2. Checked before input and on landing; no airborne collisions.
rules.river: Rows 1..5: at landing or while idle, a log must overlap abs(frog.x-log.x) <= log.length/2 + 0.2, else drown. While idle, after moving logs, check overlap then carry the frog by log.speed*dt. Drifting outside x=-6.5..6.5 is fatal.
rules.banks: Rows 12 and 6 are safe from cars and water.
rules.portals: At z=0, an unfilled portal must have abs(frog.x-portal.x)<0.5, else crash.
rules.obstacles: Each tick x+=speed*dt. Beyond x=9.5 moving right, wrap to -9.5; beyond -9.5 moving left, wrap to 9.5.
rules.countdown: Countdown reaching zero is fatal; frozen during requests.
